answer_sql:
SELECT
  p.product_name
FROM contoso_served.dim_product AS p
WHERE
  NOT p.product_key IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      s.product_key
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
    WHERE
      s.order_date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE)
  )
ORDER BY
  p.product_name
